card.name: The digit 5 in dose-reduction amounts
card.fires_on: The digit 5 when it starts a number such as 50 or 500, mostly in dose-reduction or dose-adjustment text (e.g. 'by 50%', 'to 50% of full dose'). It also fires on 5 in lab ranges or time-to-resolution counts.

modes.label: Leading 5 in percent reductions
modes.description: The digit 5 right after 'decrease/reduce the dose by' or 'to', where 0% will follow.

modes.label: 5 in numeric tables and counts
modes.description: The digit 5 inside dose-table values, counts or ranges.

card.writes: It pushes against predicting another 'five' form of the number, so the next piece is likely not a repeat of five.
card.plain: It lights up on the digit 5 that begins amounts like 50% in dose-reduction instructions.
